sentences.text: Sanpasaurus is a sauropod dinosaur belonging to the order Saurischia, a group that includes long-necked herbivores.
Later research placed this animal among basal gravisaurians, relatives of Vulcanodon and Tazoudasaurus.
The species S. yaoi was first described by Chung Chien Young in 1944.
Young noted that the bones arrived mixed at the laboratory, which made it difficult to link specific parts together.
Originally identified as an ornithopod ornithischian, the specimen was reclassified as a sauropod in 2016.
This creature lived in Sichuan province, China, during the mid-Jurassic, specifically between the Bathonian and Callovian stages.
However, the Paleobiology Database suggests an earlier time range, placing it in the Toarcian stage from 184.2 to 174.7 million years ago.
Scientists disagree on the exact time period, with some placing it in the mid-Jurassic while others argue for the earlier Toarcian.
